scope: Exploratory learning pilot specified before genomic model fitting, not a preregistered confirmatory thesis experiment
cohort: Adopt Experiment 05 conservative_cohort_option for this learning experiment only: exclude participants with any clinical case annotation/note or prior treatment not consistently No; exclude sample annotations or FFPE in either source field; then lexicographically first vial per participant/type 01 or 11. Unknown preservation remains unknown. No raw data deleted.

splits.patient_grouped: Sort participant IDs, stratify by availability of both tumor and normal versus tumor only; NumPy default_rng(seed), permute sorted IDs separately in sorted strata. First ceil(0.15*n) to test, next ceil(0.15*n) to validation, remainder train. No retry/search.
splits.site_BH_holdout: All BH participants to test. Among non-BH participants, same stratification and RNG seed, first ceil(0.15*n) in each stratum to validation, remainder train. BH chosen before any model results from prior audit showing most normal samples; not an independent external cohort.
splits.independence: Require disjoint participants and case UUIDs; one source-site code per participant matching the barcode. Sample IDs/clinical metadata are never expression predictors.
splits.comparison_limit: The two scenarios reuse participants in different roles and are dependent sensitivity analyses. Fit every model in both scenarios before inspecting either test set.

preprocessing.feature_selection: Top population variance among nonconstant expression rows on training samples only, before scaling. Descending variance, ties by versioned Ensembl ID. Each scenario selects independently. Keep exact IDs; do not collapse symbols.
preprocessing.scaling: Training mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0); no second log, imputation or clipping. Cast identical standardized values to float32 for all models.
preprocessing.layout: Selected IDs sorted lexicographically into row-major 16x16 grid; fixed arbitrary layout, not genomic order, learned similarity or SOM2IMG. No padding/collisions; exact float32 round trip.

cnn.loss: Class-weighted cross-entropy, weights N_train/(2*n_class) from training only; no oversampling. Same weights for validation selection.
cnn.selection: Lowest full-validation weighted cross-entropy; earliest exact tie; restore selected weights. No test data accepted by training function.

decision_rule: Primary Tumor when probability_tumor > 0.5, otherwise Solid Tissue Normal; fixed threshold, no tuning/calibration
model_selection: No hyperparameter search, best-seed selection or post-test retuning. Save all runs, train/validation histories, selected checkpoints and local predictions. Report three-seed mean and sample SD, not confidence intervals.
privacy: Keep raw tables, sample IDs, partitions, processed arrays, per-sample predictions and checkpoints ignored. Publish aggregate metrics, stable gene mapping, protocols and figures only.
limits: Small normal class and paired sampling
Two dependent splits, not external validation
Site holdout changes class prevalence and patient population
Weighted training outputs are not calibrated clinical risks
256-variable variance filter may omit relevant genes
Fixed layout does not encode biological similarity
No interpretation benefit or novel biological mechanism tested
